biography:
Mike is an electric power professional focused on building the grid of the future. He's at his best when leading cross-functional teams to deliver on complex projects with commercial significance under tight deadlines. His technical background is rounded out with strong commercial and regulatory experiences, giving Mike a unique perspective for addressing the electric power industry’s most pressing challenges. 

Mike completed his MBA at the UC Berkeley Haas School of Business with a focus on finance.
